public_payload.normalized_proposition: The idea that GPT-5 would be good at summarizing lots of videos fast is totally speculative, because video is way harder than text in many ways and may be quite costly computationally at scale; GPT-4 is ok at summarizing, but Marcus is not sure how much it ought to be trusted in mission-critical applications.
